create_OnTheFlyViewCellDataset: create an OnTheFlyViewCellDataset that loads color and depth images on the fly from disk during training
create_FullyLoadedViewCellDataset: create a FullyLoadedViewCellDataset that preloads all color and depth images into GPU memory at initialization
create_CameraViewCellDataset: create a CameraViewCellDataset that dynamically calculates camera positions for video rendering using a config-specified camera type
create_SampleDataWrapper: create a SampleDataWrapper to batch and yield sample data with configurable batch sizes for training loops
create_DatasetInfo: create a DatasetInfo object that parses dataset_info.json to extract camera parameters, depth ranges, and resolution settings
